The curve shows no airdrop dump, no factory flag, and a low top-3 concentration (6.7%). Buyers from the curve phase (652) are numerous.

But the case is weak. The coin is 75% off its 30-minute high and down 60% over 30 minutes. Recent flow is a bounce off a deep drawdown, not clear accumulation: sell SOL (108.75) still nearly matches buy SOL (123.56). Early post-graduation sells slightly outpaced buys (ratio 1.07), a launch bot is present, and bundle share on the curve is 29%, which is a warning sign. The pool is thin at 57.7 SOL, so a $20 round trip faces the high end of impact costs.

Verdict: no clear case that demand will hold for the next 30-60 minutes. The bounce is real but unproven, and the base rates for buying into a post-graduation coin at this stage are poor. Recommend SKIP.
memos.skeptic:

The last-15-minute +59% bounce is the trap: sells (108.75 SOL) nearly matched buys (123.56 SOL), with 137 sellers against 179 buyers, so holders are exiting into strength. Net flow is only +14.8 SOL, too thin to sustain the move.

Fees matter here. With a 58 SOL pool and a 1.4-5.1% round trip, a $20 ticket needs a sustained move well above that just to break even, and the bounce has already been faded once. The bundle share (29%) and launch bot presence point to coordinated early buying that may be exit liquidity for those who entered late. Skip.
